notes: The Opportunity Surface fill has been running for hours at a time for months. Nobody had ever asked what it *costs*, because nothing recorded it. Asked directly, the answer was ~594,000 HTTP requests for one full-universe pass — and the reason is not the provider, the plan or the network. The per-symbol model build issued 112 requests for 19 distinct URLs, including 22 identical profile?symbol=KO fetches in a single build, because the share-count rebase runs once per model across a 23-model registry.
